purpose: Deep labeling registry — every stock in the Finviz universe is decomposed into stable segment tags ('what is it?'). Bin edges live HERE, not in code, so lessons/Deepthink can retune thresholds without touching src/segments.py. Backtesting is deliberately out of scope at this stage: this registry defines LABELS ONLY.

size.note: standard cap bands; micro/small ~ Russell 2000 territory

short.note: crowding; extreme is its own bucket because squeeze/stress dynamics dominate there

liq.source_unit: Average Volume is thousands of shares
liq.note: dollar average daily volume; low-liquidity names gap on news

rvol.note: participation TODAY vs its own norm; fast-moving label

vol.note: ATR%% of price = the name's own volatility regime

profit.note: profitability; unprofitable names are a different animal in risk-off

lev.note: leverage amplifies whatever regime is running

style.growth_when: Sales Year Over Year TTM >= 15 OR EPS Growth Next Year >= 20
style.value_when: Forward P/E <= 15 AND Sales Year Over Year TTM < 10
style.note: coarse growth/value/blend proxy from Finviz fields only

mom.rule: above 50DMA and above 200DMA -> uptrend; below both -> downtrend; else mixed
mom.note: SMA columns are %% distance from the average, so sign is the test

ext.note: parabolic / overbought / washed-out state; precedence extreme > extended > washed

range.status: INACTIVE — source columns not in current Finviz export; every name gets range:unknown until the export includes them
range.note: x = (P - L52)/(H52 - L52); Finviz stores 52w fields as %% distances so L52=P/(1+lo), H52=P/(1+hi); breakout when price >= H52

earn.status: INACTIVE — column not in current Finviz export; every name gets earn:unknown
earn.note: earnings proximity gate; activates when the export includes Earnings Date

themes.source: CATALYST_PATTERNS in src/finviz_delta.py over News Title + Daily Digest
themes.note: theme:<name> tags; same keyword engine the scoring features use
